import json
from pathlib import Path


def triad_paths(festival_id):
    return {"validation": Path(f"/data/{festival_id}/validation.json")}


def generate_rule_triads(rules):
    for rule in rules:
        validation_path = triad_paths(rule.festival_id)["validation"]
        payload = json.loads(validation_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        _use(payload)
